title: Field of Life — Reaction-Diffusion Scientific Descendant
status: archive-generated scientific descendant of a historical project metaphor; not evidence for a fundamental life field
abstract: The historical Potatoverse Field of Life compares living organization to excitation in a field. This descendant does not promote that metaphor into fundamental physics. It asks a narrower scientific question: whether one explicitly measured biological or ecological spatial variable can be modeled as a reaction-diffusion field with declared transport, local dynamics, source terms, boundary conditions, observables and baselines. The model is scientifically useful only when phi(x,t) is tied to a real density, concentration, occupancy or other measurable proxy, and when spatial coupling improves prediction relative to simpler local or network models.
research_question: For one specified biological or ecological dataset, does an explicit spatial field model predict the measured pattern better than local-only, diffusion-only or graph-spread baselines, and is the field representation necessary for that application?

provenance.historical_status: Field of Life language is book-derived speculative/metaphorical material.
provenance.scientific_descendant_authorship: The reaction-diffusion model below is a later archive-generated descendant using established external mathematics; it is not recovered Tim-authored physics.

state_space.domain: A declared spatial domain Omega with coordinate x and time t.
state_space.state: phi(x,t), a measurable scalar density, concentration, occupancy fraction or explicitly defined proxy.
state_space.units: Units depend on the chosen application; examples include mol m^-3, organisms m^-2, biomass kg m^-2 or a dimensionless occupancy fraction.

equations.general: partial_t phi = D nabla^2 phi + f(phi;theta) + S(x,t)
equations.noise: epsilon_i is assigned a stated measurement distribution/covariance rather than absorbed into the dynamics.

parameters.theta: parameters of the local reaction/growth/decay law
parameters.r: growth rate in the logistic example, units 1/time
parameters.K: carrying-capacity scale with the same units as phi
parameters.S: external source/sink term with units phi/time

boundary_options: no-flux: n dot grad(phi)=0 on boundary
periodic: opposite boundaries identified where the physical domain warrants it
initial_and_boundary_conditions.rule: The boundary condition is part of the model and must not be chosen after inspecting which option gives the desired pattern.

validity_regime: The coarse field approximation is appropriate only when the chosen spatial scale is large enough that a continuous density/proxy is meaningful.
Anisotropic transport, discrete individuals, advection, chemotaxis or network topology require explicit extensions rather than being hidden inside D.
The logistic reaction law is an established comparator, not a Potato-specific law.

baselines.purpose: Tests whether spatial coupling adds predictive value.
Tests whether local reaction terms are necessary.

baselines.model: same conventional reaction-diffusion family without project-specific interpretation
baselines.purpose: Separates scientific performance from Potatoverse naming.
Preferred comparator when the true substrate is graph-like rather than Euclidean space.

observables: spatial concentration/density maps at declared times
front speed or spread radius where meaningful
pattern wavelength or mode spectrum where a patterned state exists
held-out prediction error or predictive likelihood

procedure: Choose one dataset and freeze the definition of phi, spatial scale and time step.
Estimate measurement noise separately from process dynamics where possible.
Fit the simplest baseline first, then the full reaction-diffusion model.
Report parameter uncertainty and practical identifiability, especially D versus reaction-rate tradeoffs.
Evaluate on held-out times/regions or by predictive cross-validation when the dataset supports it.
calibration_path.maturity_boundary: This record remains T2 because no dataset is fitted here. T3 requires actual parameter constraints or calibration results with provenance.

limiting_cases: If spatial coupling does not improve prediction over local dynamics, the field interpretation is unnecessary for that application.
falsifiers: The proposed phi cannot be measured reproducibly or its measurement map is undefined.
A simpler local or network baseline predicts as well or better after complexity penalties.
Fitted parameters are non-identifiable over the available measurement precision.
The selected model violates known conservation/positivity constraints in the claimed domain.
No project-specific mapping adds explanatory or predictive value beyond ordinary reaction-diffusion language.
epistemic_boundary: A successful reaction-diffusion fit would validate only the selected biological/ecological model. It would not establish a universal metaphysical Field of Life, a new quantum field, or a fundamental force.
